subject: Cloud Computing
title: CDN to Compute: Cloudflare Workers
description: One-minute skill: CDN to Compute: Cloudflare Workers.

hook.text: CDNs used to just cache static files. Now Cloudflare Workers runs your code at 300 locations worldwide in milliseconds.

buildup.text: Traditional serverless runs in one region. Edge functions run at the CDN edge — whichever node is closest to the user.

discovery.text: Workers uses V8 isolates instead of containers. Startup: under 5 milliseconds. Cold starts are nearly eliminated.

twist.text: Edge functions have constraints: limited CPU, smaller memory, no filesystem. You write code differently for the edge.

climax.text: Deno Deploy, Vercel Edge, and Fastly Compute all offer similar models. The edge runtime is becoming a new standard.

punchline.text: Your code runs in 300 cities. Five milliseconds cold start.

quiz.question: How do Cloudflare Workers achieve near-zero cold starts?
options: They use lightweight V8 isolates instead of full containers
They keep every function running permanently at all locations
They predict which functions will be called and pre-load them

details.summary: Cloudflare Workers transformed CDNs from passive content caches into active compute platforms. Code runs in over 300 locations worldwide with sub-millisecond cold starts, enabling full applications at the edge. This evolution blurs the line between CDN and cloud provider.
details.whyItMatters: Edge compute platforms like Workers challenge the centralized cloud model. Running application logic globally at the edge creates faster user experiences than any single-region deployment can achieve.
takeaways: Workers run application code in over 300 global locations
Cold starts are under one millisecond using V8 isolates
CDNs are evolving from content caches to compute platforms

faq.question: How do Workers achieve such fast cold starts?
faq.answer: Workers use V8 JavaScript isolates instead of containers or VMs. Isolates share a single process, eliminating the overhead of spinning up new runtime environments. This provides sub-millisecond startup times compared to seconds for traditional serverless cold starts.

faq.question: What can you build with edge compute?
faq.answer: Full web applications, API gateways, authentication systems, A/B testing, image optimization, geolocation-based routing, and real-time personalization all work at the edge. Paired with edge storage and databases, complete applications can run without a traditional cloud backend.
